environment.description: Same NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS Application Load Balancer (ALB) with an associated AWS WAFv2 Web ACL. The Web ACL includes the AWS managed rule group 'AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet' with all rules in default action (BLOCK), and a custom rule with priority 1 that inspects request headers using a regex pattern set matching concurrent presence of both 'transfer-encoding' and 'content-length' headers with action BLOCK. The ALB itself normalizes HTTP/1.1 requests by stripping duplicate or conflicting hop-by-hop headers before forwarding to targets. ALB listener configured with HTTP/1.1 only (HTTP/2 disabled via attribute routing.http2.enabled=false). The ALB's built-in HTTP request parsing rejects malformed chunked encoding and ambiguous message framing per RFC 7230 Section 3.3.3, returning 400 before the request reaches the application.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with HTTP/1.1 strict parsing

waf_rules.name: block-smuggling-headers
waf_rules.statement: RegexPatternSet match on headers: concurrent transfer-encoding + content-length

config.network: ALB in public subnet, ECS tasks in private subnet, security group allows inbound only from ALB
